payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort beacons by position, then use DP to compute dp[i]: max saved beacons if i-th is active, using binary search to find untouched leftmost beacon. Answer n - max(dp).
payload.rationale: The solution first sorts by position, then iteratively computes dp[i] based on binary search in previous coordinates. This is a classic 1D DP where state i depends on a prefix state determined by the destruction range. Sorting is only preprocessing.
